chapters.chapter_name: The Heritage of India: Unity in Diversity
content: Architecture and Sculpture: Indus Valley town planning, rock cut
architecture, major styles of temples, Mughal architecture, modern
and contemporary architecture, stone and metal sculpture, Painting:
Ajanta murals, Mughal paintings, Madhubani paintings, paintings of
Jharkhand (Kohbar, Sohrai, Jadopatia, etc.)., Music and Dance:
Overview of various forms of music and dances in India
dance of Jharkhand and Odisha, Science, Technology and Medicine:
A general survey of the progress of science, technology and
Traditional Knowledge System: Gurukuls, Pathsalas, Tols, Maktabs
Madrasas, Beginnings of Modern Education: Main features of
British Government’s educational policies., Growth of higher and
The struggle for Independence (1885-1947) , Framing of the Indian
Fundamental Rights and Duties , India’s Foreign
Policy: Main Elements (Non Alignment, Panchsheel) , Panchayati
Raj in India with special reference to PESA in Jharkhand
